title: Broadcast
empty.description: Live OBS overlays for your stream, one broadcast per cast channel. Mark a match as casted and its rosters, maps, score and bracket show up on the overlays by themselves, while you switch scenes from a single dashboard.
empty.getStarted: Add your cast channel to get started.
empty.askOrganizer: Ask an organizer of the tournament to add a cast channel to get started.
dashboard.holdHint: Keeps Next off air until you Take
dashboard.noScannerHint: No scanner is connected, so Next waits for a Take
dashboard.duration.label: On air for
dashboard.duration.countdown: The remaining time is counted down on the scene. With Until Take, no countdown is shown.
dashboard.queue.clipMissing: Not every OBS source has this clip yet. Until they do, the scene shows the OBS footage instead.
dashboard.rehearseHint: Plays the transition on the Next preview, nothing goes on air
dashboard.needsMatch: Needs a match cast on this channel
dashboard.matchScenesOff: Rosters, maps and results need a match cast on this channel.
dashboard.noFeaturedMatch: No match is cast on this channel. Mark one as casted (or lock one for it) from the match page.
dashboard.resultsNotOnAir_one: {{count}} result not on air yet: live shows {{live}}, the set is at {{next}}. The next Take puts it on air.
dashboard.resultsNotOnAir_other: {{count}} results not on air yet: live shows {{live}}, the set is at {{next}}. The next Take puts them on air.
dashboard.bracket.explanation: Remaining shows only the rounds still being played. Picking a round shows every round from it on, finished ones too.
dashboard.bracket.none: There is no started bracket to show.
dashboard.team.label: Team
dashboard.team.explanation: Any team of the tournament. The featured match's teams follow the match being cast, in the colors of their sides.
dashboard.clips.label: Clip
dashboard.clips.explanation: Without a clip, the scene shows the footage OBS has under the overlay.
dashboard.setup.clipsSynced: Every OBS source has every replay clip
dashboard.setup.program: In OBS, create a new scene collection (Scene Collection → New) so your own setup stays untouched. Add your capture card and on top of it a Browser source with the URL below, sized 1920×1080 (also set the canvas size in Settings → Video). It switches scenes by itself when you Take. The URL is yours and stays the same for every channel and tournament: it shows the broadcast where you last pressed Show this broadcast.
dashboard.setup.noProgramKey: Your browser source URL has a secret key, so only you can show the overlay. Generate it once: it stays the same for every channel and tournament, and Show this broadcast moves it to the broadcast you're producing.
dashboard.setup.pointProgramDescription: Your browser source URL shows {{channelName}} in {{tournamentName}}. The OBS sources using it stop showing that broadcast and switch to this one right away: if that stream is live, its overlay is gone.
dashboard.setup.programShowsThis: Your browser source URL shows this broadcast
dashboard.setup.programShowsOther: Your browser source URL shows {{channelName}} in {{tournamentName}}
dashboard.setup.programShowsNothing: Your browser source URL shows no broadcast
dashboard.setup.regenerateKeyHeading: Generate a new browser source URL?
dashboard.setup.regenerateKeyDescription: The current URL stops working and the OBS sources using it disconnect. Paste the new URL into OBS afterwards.
dashboard.setup.obsAudio: Your browser source mutes the capture card in OBS on every scene but Game, and unmutes it when the game is back on. In OBS, turn on Enable WebSocket server (Tools → WebSocket Server Settings) and fill in its port and password here. Saved with your browser source URL, so they stay the same for every channel and tournament.
dashboard.setup.obsSources.unreachable: Couldn't reach OBS to list its sources. Open this page on the computer OBS runs on and check its WebSocket server is on and the port is right, or type the source's name.
dashboard.setup.obsSources.none: OBS has no sources yet. Add your capture card first.
dashboard.setup.casters: Paste each caster's VDO.ninja view link to show their camera in the Casters scene and play their sound on every scene. Without a camera (or a link) their avatar shows instead. In OBS, check "Control audio via OBS" in the browser source's properties so the casters reach the stream's audio. Their volume is set in the Mixer under the live preview.
dashboard.setup.scanner: Start the scanner from this page's header in the browser that sees the game feed without this overlay (your capture card, or OBS Virtual Camera of a scene with only the capture card). It puts scenes waiting for a game start or end on air, in the teams' ink colors. Games still upload to sendou.ink as usual.
dashboard.setup.scannerLinkedElsewhere: This browser's scanner is linked to another broadcast. Linking it here moves it.
dashboard.ink.clear: Clear, back to the theme's colors
dashboard.theme.designHint: Edit every style of the overlays while previewing them over gameplay in made-up situations.
overlay.standBy: Please stand by, we'll be right back
design.title: Designer
design.headline: Flavour text
design.presetHint: A preset's CSS is loaded into Custom CSS to make your own from. Nothing changes on air before you save.
design.presetConfirm.heading: Replace your edits?
design.presetConfirm.description: Loading {{preset}} replaces every edit you have made to the styles.
design.stylesheetHint: Colors, type, and at the top the sizes and spots everything follows. Saving keeps only what you changed.
design.layoutHint: How the parts are laid out and animated. Most changes are easier in the sizes and spots at the top of the look stylesheet.
design.customHint: Your own CSS, applied after everything else, e.g. for [data-part="team-name"] across every scene.
design.variablesHint: Put the cursor on a line to get shortcuts to its variables, or ⌘/Ctrl + click one to jump to where it is set.
design.syntaxError: Line {{line}}: {{reason}}. The preview shows your last edit that worked.
design.noChanges: Nothing changed from the default styles
design.tooLong: Too many changes to save, at most {{max}} characters fit.
